_comment: agentmux adapter for Claude Code. Merge the 'hooks' object into ~/.claude/settings.json. Requires `agentmux` on PATH and jq. $PPID inside a hook command is the Claude Code process (used for stale-state cleanup, Q-005; unverified, see Q-015). PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure set working so an approved permission prompt stops showing waiting once the tool finishes.

hooks.command: m=$(jq -r '.message // empty'); case $m in *ermission*) r=permission;; *) r=input;; esac; agentmux set waiting --reason $r --msg "$m" --harness claude --pid $PPID
